channel.title: BucketMate Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
Version 1.0


  • 🚀 New feature/improvement:

+ Add Google Cloud Storage support

+ Add pin bucket support

+ Add bucket emptying with confirmation alerts

+ Add typed confirmation for bucket deletion

+ Show saved bucket list on app launch

+ Update cache lifetime to 7 days for saved buckets and metadata


  • 🐛 Bug fix:

+ Fix Google Cloud share link behavior

+ Fix preview image scroll behavior



Version 0.9


  • 🚀 New feature/improvement:

+ Support AWS SSO connections

+ Add support for credentials that don't have permission to list buckets

+ Add customizable keyboard shortcuts

+ Add theme switch (light/dark mode)

+ Add share links (presigned URLs) with history and search

+ Add file detail view with folder size and custom domain URLs

+ Add auto-update configuration

+ Improve performance and reduce RAM usage


  • 🐛 Bug fix:

+ Fix app hanging when connection error occurs

+ Fix UI flicker when switching buckets

+ Improve error messages



Version 0.8


  • 🚀 New feature/improvement:

+ Optimize performance for large buckets that have a lot of files.

+ Support Intel chips with Universal build.


  • 🐛 Bug fix:

+ Fix upload issue that sometimes ignores some files.

+ Prevent upload issues when switching between buckets/connections while uploading.

+ Improve notification messages when processing changes.



Version 0.7


  • 🚀 New feature / improvement:

+ Improve caching



Version 0.6


  • 🚀 New feature / improvement:

+ Change upload UI from dialog to popover

+ Show file count when select multiple files

+ Multi-select - allow copying files and URLs with separator

+ Support creating folder from folder context menu

+ Allow creating folder when downloading

+ Change pin connect behavior

+ Show folder size

+ Delete files faster

+ Support uploading whole folders

+ Add menu to send bugs and feedback


  • 🐛 Bug fix:

+ Fix incorrect file counts between places on UI

+ Fix incorrect multi-select with shortcut

+ Fix bucket load race condition between connections

+ Fix delete selected files/folders functionality

+ Persist hidden bucket status



Version 0.5


  • 🚀 New feature / improvement:

+ Add support for create folder

+ Add MinIO provider support


  • 🐛 Bug fix:

+ Persist preview panel state and window size

+ Allow connect single bukcet connection without error

+ Avoid duplicate selected, highlight the same named bucket.

+ Remove loading when API call is finished

+ Fix rename and delete folder issues



Version 0.4


  • 🚀 New feature / improvement:

+ Allow hide bucket

+ Improve loading to avoid layout shift


  • 🐛 Bug fix:

+ Multi-select issue

+ CMD+F to focus search input when searching



Version 0.3


  • 🚀 New feature / improvement:

+ Add support for PDF inline preview

+ Add support for Wasabi provider

+ Support for hierarchy navigation in the file list with folder and breadcrumb

+ Folder: support rename and delete

+ Add deselect shortcut (ESC)

+ Support to pin connection to the top of the list


  • 🐛 Bug fix:

+ Correct DO space regions

+ Correct Add connection validation



Version 0.2


  • 🚀 New feature: Support custom region values when add new connection
  • 🐛 Bug fix: Not able to perform some actions of some S3 providers (e.g., Infomaniak, MinIO).
  • 🐛 Bug fix: Fix a issue when uploading files that lead to crash app.


Version 0.1


  • 🚀 First release ever!
  • 👉 Go to bucketmate.app to download the app!!
